section.title: Technical Product Leadership
section.intro: From software engineering foundations to leading product direction, organizational execution, and complex B2B SaaS platform delivery.

groups.title: Technical Foundation
groups.subtitle: Senior Web Programmer / Web Developer / WordPress Developer
groups.summary: Seven years of production engineering shaped how I evaluate feasibility, integration complexity, and implementation trade-offs long before they become delivery problems.

items.summary: Built product structure and execution discipline, defined product direction, and drove the TMS platform from fragmented efforts to production launch, validated by 10 beta carrier companies.

details.title: Organizational Leadership
items: Led a 40-person cross-functional execution organization across frontend, backend, mobile, QA, and design.
Acted as the primary leadership bridge between the CEO and technical teams.
Held formal authority over hiring, firing, performance reviews, compensation decisions, and disciplinary actions.
Conducted regular 1:1s, performance assessments, delivery monitoring, and team feedback loops.

details.title: Product Strategy
items: Inherited a fragmented multi-year product effort and redefined it into a cohesive MVP-ready B2B SaaS platform.
Owned MVP definition, Version 1 scope, roadmap planning, prioritization, epic structure, acceptance logic, and release decisions.
Contributed to pricing, billing architecture, subscription logic, and monetization decisions.

details.title: Technical Product
items: Led technical product decisions across backend, web, mobile, APIs, integrations, and operational workflows.
Worked with engineering leadership on architecture discussions, technical trade-offs, and implementation planning.
Evaluated implementation direction for mobile technical decisions, including geofence-related solutions.

details.title: Execution & Delivery
items: Led execution across engineering, QA, design, infrastructure, and business stakeholders.
Worked directly with beta customers through demos, interviews, validation, and structured feedback loops.
Built prioritization frameworks, requirement standards, release processes, and delivery discipline.

details.title: Platform & Integrations
items: Owned product direction across dispatch, loads, payroll, billing, authentication, OCR workflows, and operational platform modules.
Directed external technical integrations including ELD/API/vendor evaluations and engineering coordination.

items.summary: Led technical product delivery and roadmap execution across revenue-critical engineering teams supporting affiliate marketing infrastructure and internal monetization platforms.

details.title: Technical Product Delivery
items: Led roadmap execution and technical product delivery across distributed engineering teams in revenue-critical commercial environments.
Balanced business priorities, engineering capacity, and delivery constraints to support commercially important platform decisions.
Translated complex stakeholder requirements into structured execution plans that improved delivery clarity and decision-making.

details.title: Platform Modernization
items: Led modernization initiatives across internal monetization platforms and affiliate infrastructure supporting large-scale commercial operations.
Worked with engineering teams on modernization planning, implementation strategy, and execution coordination.

details.title: Commercial Delivery Leadership
items: Led commercial delivery execution for production-critical systems during high-traffic business events.
Managed delivery risk, dependency alignment, and execution coordination across engineering teams in commercially sensitive environments.

items.summary: Implemented Spotify model and scaled agile delivery across 2 global engineering teams supporting 3500+ sites. Built execution discipline and cross-team handoff practices that shaped long-term team execution.

details.title: Transformation Leadership
items: Helped implement a Spotify-inspired operating model as part of Better Collective’s agile transformation across global engineering teams.
Defined Jira structures, workflow standards, execution processes, and delivery frameworks across teams with different operating models.

details.title: Execution Alignment
items: Worked across product and engineering teams to improve prioritization clarity, execution discipline, planning quality, and stakeholder alignment.
Built predictable execution practices around estimation, delivery coordination, dependency management, and team operating rhythm.

details.title: Leadership Evolution
items: Evolved from delivery-focused agile leadership into broader technical product ownership, execution leadership, and business-aligned decision-making.

items.summary: Worked on web platforms and development workflows, connecting implementation quality with business and product needs.
Delivered frontend and WordPress-based web work while supporting technical decisions and implementation consistency.
Built and maintained web properties in a performance and content-driven product environment.
Developed and maintained web experiences, gaining practical grounding in production web delivery.
Worked on web development implementation and delivery foundations across client-oriented projects.
Started professional web development work across WordPress and frontend implementation.
Archived early support leadership role retained in JSON for future use.
